depends_on: F.3.8;Alarcon-Forstneric Proposition 7.13(d) and Definition 7.7
notes: Continuous sections exist over a graph spine. The actual LSAP fibre-bundle section theorem is applied. Good reduction and logarithmic bounded correction at missing punctures remain separate.

statement: An open Grassmannian submersion over an open Riemann surface, with LSAP bundle fibres away from finitely many retained points, satisfies the relative section principle for an initially holomorphic section near those points.
depends_on: F.3.8;Alarcon-Forstneric Lemma 5.1 and Theorem 6.1;Forstneric-Prezelj Theorem 1.2
notes: Explicit End(V) ideal sprays dominate all attaching arcs while fixing jets. Critical Mergelyan approximation keeps the base coordinate fixed. Root and maps independently audited the proof and exact primary ingredients.

statement: Every oriented rank-six monodromy datum on a punctured sphere with a maximal square-zero cusp admits nondegenerate holomorphic periods with any finite jet of the bounded holomorphic cusp correction; hence literal F.3 is settled for every F.2 survivor.
notes: Adjoin an affine C9 cusp fibre in the canonical Grassmannian bundle and apply the relative principle on the open sphere with the other punctures removed. All-new-bumps avoid the cusp. Simultaneous finite good reduction is a stronger separate condition. Two independent audits passed.

statement: The explicit compact complex fourfold is three-connected with Euler number six and is oriented diffeomorphic to 3HP2#(-HP2).
